name: Blur Background
desc: Free background blur for video calls. No sign in, no watermark, and it runs fully in the browser.
line: Chrome extension that blurs the background on any video call site, on device, with no sign in and no watermark.

name: Full Webpage Screenshot
desc: Captures a whole page beyond the fold with no network calls.
line: Chrome extension that captures a whole page beyond the fold in one pass at full resolution, with no network calls.

name: Teacher Fundraising Message Generator
desc: Describe what a classroom needs and get a polished donor ask, ready to send.
line: Describe what a classroom needs and get a donor ask ready to send, as an email or a short social post, using only what was said.

name: Leave Broadcast Message Generator
desc: Who is out, when, and what needs handing off, as one clean message.
line: Who is out, when, and what needs handing off goes in. One clean broadcast message comes out, ready for Slack, email or WhatsApp.

name: GitHub Profile Summarizer
desc: Paste a GitHub username and get a summary of what that person has shipped.
line: Paste a GitHub username and get a recruiter-readable summary of what that person has actually shipped, computed from the GitHub API.

name: Fieldnote
desc: A spoken classroom observation becomes a clean structured report with highlights and flags.
line: Speak or type a messy classroom observation and get a clean report with highlights, flags and next steps.

name: Contract Generator
desc: Agreements drafted in minutes instead of days of back and forth. Still needs a human read before anyone signs.
line: Fill in a modular form for a joining letter or exit agreement and get a draft ready for a human read, exported to PDF.
